question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is __**voice**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **voice **means the sounds you make when speaking or singing; your ability to make these sounds.
 
• *Example *: I love my **voice **
 
• The **meaning** of above sentence is that as the sound of her throat was very
